snippet.title: Danmaku Unlimited 4 WYVER ULTRA - 3D Bullet Hell Action | Steam First Look
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3575710/Danmaku_Unlimited_4_WYVER_ULTRA/

Arise Wyver and fly against overwhelming odds! Presenting Danmaku Unlimited 4 WYVER ULTRA, a classic bullet hell shoot'em up inspired by legends past, in glorious 4K/120FPS. 

Danmaku Unlimited 4 WYVER ULTRA is a labor of love that perfectly blends stylish cinematic shmup action with nail-biting bullet hell gameplay.

FEATURES
-Classic Bullet Hell Shoot'em up in glorious 4K and 120FPS on a custom homebrew engine

-Turn the storm of enemy bullets into powerful attacks with the WYVER Blade System 

-Fly solo or local coop with a variety of fighters to choose from

-Multiple game modes and difficulties for newcomers and genre veterans alike

-Epic soundtracks by BLANKFIELD

-Replay system to revisit or share your perfect run

-Online Leaderboards and Achievements
